1.why: disappear/wander/tumble/gather are all physical motion verbs and hesitate is the only volitional-mental one, but the partition is thin enough that this is close to a coin flip.

2.why: The set is one key perturbed along the -less suffix; spotless is the only positively-valenced member among four fault-words (tactless, shameless, reckless, listless).

3.why: narrow/hollow/fragile form a physical-property cluster leaving dreary and hasty both outside, so no single option is isolated.

4.why: abbreviate/distribute/assemble/translate all transform or move an external object; memorize is the only internal mental act, i.e. the odd one out by relation to an object.

5.why: Relation parity: grind:mill and brew:kettle are verb-to-instrument, knead:bread and churn:butter are verb-to-product, leaving tan:hide as the lone verb-to-raw-material pair.

6.why: All five are two-word phrasal verbs of the same shape; 'wear away' reads as the only gradual-attrition sense but settle down is an equally defensible outlier.

7.why: spout/shelf/label/cork are all parts or fittings of the whole named second, while crate:fruit reverses to container:contents.

8.why: patriot, apprentice, hermit and arbiter all attach to or serve the second term; iconoclast is the only figure defined by opposing it.

9.why: weaver:yarn, carpenter:workbench, baker:oven and sculptor:statue all pair a worker with a material, tool or product; tailor:customer is the only pair whose second term is a person.

10.why: trellis/banister/awning share a support-or-provide function, but girder:steel (composition) and quarry:stone (source) are both outside it, so two options are odd rather than one.

11.why: sermon:congregation and anthem:nation are utterance:audience, joke:laughter and riddle:answer are utterance:response, leaving whisper:secret as the lone manner:content pair.

12.why: All five are -ous adjectives; tedious/laborious/hazardous share an unpleasant-task sense, but spontaneous and ingenious are both outside it.

13.why: generous, curious, restless and strict are dispositional or moral traits; clumsy is the only physical-coordination trait (same rule that isolates clumsy in item 28).

14.why: elegy:funeral, sonnet:rhyme, diatribe:censure and epitaph:stone pair a literary form with an occasion, feature, purpose or medium; satire:novelist is the only form:person pair.

15.why: All five are un- adjectives; unwieldy is the only one built on a bound stem, but unrivaled is the only positive one, so two competing structural tells point different ways.

16.why: stain and mess are physical disorder, delay and shortage are logistical lack, and silence is the unpaired singleton (and the only one that can be desirable).

17.why: erosion, polish, tarnish and mildew are all processes acting on a surface or quality; kiln is the only device, an outlier by word class as well as relation.

18.why: wave:shore, dune:wind, pebble:beach and crater:moon all relate a feature to a place or shaping force; glacier:ice is the only material-composition pair.

19.why: stubborn, talkative, wasteful and showy are plain everyday adjectives; surly is the only raised-register item, the standard tell for the tested word.

20.why: postpone/repeal/amend are legislative acts and enforce/endorse form a near-homophone pair, so the partition identifies a group of three rather than one option.

21.why: usher and patron both pair with a venue while archivist, editor and critic pair with objects; patron is the only one who neither works on nor judges the second term, but the split is unstable.

22.why: stir/soak/polish/scatter are all agent-applied treatments and freeze is the only one that happens without an agent, but all five are ordinary transitive verbs.

23.why: bewildering/threatening/exhausting are negative-effect participles, leaving refreshing and flattering both positive, so no single option is isolated.

24.why: luminous:lamp, sterile:clinic and opaque:glass are adjective:object, leaving insipid:flavor (adjective:quality denied) and brittle:snap (adjective:verb) as two competing outliers.

25.why: bark:tree and resin:pine are plant products, vein:marble and knot:rope are flaws or figures within a material, leaving mortar:brick as the only manufactured joining agent.

26.why: crack, melt, shine and float are visible physical behaviours of matter; echo is the only acoustic verb.

27.why: pepper:sneeze and salt:preserve are substance:effect while vinegar:sour is taste and honey:bee is source; lemon:fruit is the only class-membership pair but three relations are unpaired.

28.why: rude, stingy, lazy and greedy are moral or character faults; clumsy is the only physical one.

29.why: rabbit, horse and bee make the second term an animal in three options, leaving hive:honey and pasture:fence both outside, so the isolation is not unique.

30.why: tadpole, calf and fledgling are young animals, so the first term marks cocoon:silk and swarm:locust as the two outsiders; cocoon is the only inanimate object but swarm is equally unmatched.
